“衣服是买了，但是在老林子里面，可没干什么事情。”李青山一五一十道。

“真的？”

柔雪继续盯着李青山的眼睛问道。

“嗯！”

李青山点头。

“其实，春晓是个不错的姑娘，在咱们村里，甚至在十里八村都是一朵金花，还是个黄花大闺女。”

“我只是一个寡妇，还带着一个闺女。”

“我这样的人，你是不能娶的，我也不是不懂分寸的女人，你就算是想要娶我，我也不会嫁给你。”

“你要是也觉得春晓不错，就去娶了她。”

“否则，春晓要是嫁给别人的话，可就有你后悔的了，而且这姑娘肯定对你也有意思，否则不可能要你的那一身裙子。”

“等到你结婚之后呢！”

“要是想得起我，还愿意来找我，就来寻我，我们就做一对野鸳鸯，你若是不想找我了，倒也无妨，就把我忘掉就是了。”

柔雪盯着李青山，语气温柔道：“这就是我的心里话，也是我心里想的。”

李青山望着眼前的柔雪沉默了。

这是一个非常懂分寸，也懂事的女人，你若是愿意寻我，我们便做野鸳鸯，若是不愿意寻我，就当无事发生。

懂事的，令人心疼！

“婚姻也许不会一辈子！”

“但是，我们可以做一辈子的鸳鸯。”

李青山望着眼前懂事的柔雪，话语中已经给了柔雪答案。

深夜。

一对野鸳鸯戏于水中。

次日一早。

李青山离开的时候，天色已经亮了，扶着墙开了门，家里早餐的香味已经传了出来。

“青山，吃饭了！”老娘将饭菜端在桌子上，开口道。

“吃过了。”

李青山摆了摆手，今天早上在柔雪家中吃的，不得不说，就算是早餐，柔雪做的都比老娘做的好吃，手艺真是绝了。

“吃过了？”

“你在哪里吃的？”

老娘，柳桂香，王乃香和李三奎都是微微一怔，目光朝着李青山望了过来。

坏了……！

“哦，刚刚我去河边遛弯，抓了条鱼，烤了吃了！”

“不说了，我得去一趟后院，尽快把麝香取了。”

李青山说罢，连忙扶着墙朝着后院走去。

“青山，你腰这是咋了，没事吧？”柳桂香开口问道。

“哦，没事，抓鱼的时候闪了腰，不碍事，不碍事……你们先吃……！”

李青山擦了一把额头上的冷汗道。

“怎么感觉青山，怪怪的？”

柳桂香眉头微皱，王乃香，李青山的老娘也都是有这个想法。

李青山回到房间后，首先将在山上调配好的草药汁水取了出来，此物是用曼陀罗调配而成，这东西听起来不像是咱们这边的，其实在老林子里面也算是常见的，日后若是山上遇到了，最好能够栽培一下回来。

后院，木围子内。

獐子被绳子拴着，趴在地上小憩，可能实在是无聊。

至于香獐子就快活许多了，不断在木围子内渡步，如今天气的温度越来越高了，木围子里面没有树木被围进去，这些香獐子想要寻找乘凉的地方都不好寻，天天呆在窝里也不行，所以木围子还要继续扩张，最好是能这整个后山的小山坡全部围上，这里是自己家的后院，一旦围上了，这片地方几乎相当于是自己的了。

等到明年夏天后，一贡献给政府，全部都合法了。

这香獐子养殖园，其实更像是自己的庇护所所用，自己家的家人只要在里面挂个名头，就能够免于受到冲击。

当然了，现在想要扩张到整个后山的山坡。

明显不太现实。

先扩张个一亩地吧，这样就有一半以上的区域，会将树木扩充进来，香獐子在夏日的时候也就有了乘凉的场地。

现在香獐子养殖，李青山打算交给自己的老父亲管理，自己可没这个时间，至于什么注意事项，技巧，都可以慢慢交给他，然后再过渡到自己老娘，甚至是自己嫂子身上。

至于王乃香，则是盯着了保健站那里！！

李青山掏出玉葫芦吊坠，里面竟然再次产生了一滴液体，这让李青山脸上流露出一抹喜色。

刚刚打开瓶塞。

一股淡雅的香味便朝着四周飘荡，这股味道十分清淡，李青山凑近了才能够勉强闻到一些，但是木围子内的獐子和香獐子却闻到了，纷纷朝着李青山走了过来，只是那只獐子被绳子拴着，也走不过来。

李青山将玉葫芦内的液体倒在嫩叶上，朝着香獐子递了过去，舌头一卷，嫩叶便被卷入口中咀嚼。

这只香獐子一夜未见，似乎也壮实了不少。

精神也好上了许多。

自己的猜测果然没错，这玉葫芦的液体，果然对这些动物果然是有好处的，可以促进成长。

木围子里面留下一只香獐子就足够了。

至于另外一只獐子，可以考虑今天宰杀了剥皮，毕竟家里也没多少肉了，得补充一下，这只獐子得作用，也差不多结束了。

紧接着。

李青山取出自己调配得曼陀罗药液，涂抹在嫩叶上，喂给眼前得香獐子，这香獐子吃下没多久，便倒在地上昏厥过去。

找一块干净得木板，将香獐子放在上面。

伸手拍了拍香獐子得脸，发现真的晕的很深，李青山这才满意的点了点头，现在想要取走香獐子的麝香，一共有三种方法，分别是捅槽法，手术法，等压法这三种方法。

手术法最为暴力，也是李青山绝对不会用的方法，就是直接剖开，然后缝合，死亡率极其高，毕竟现在无论是卫生还是器械都达不到这个要求。

第二个方法是等压法，这个方法倒是还可以，就是挤压香獐子的香囊，用一些类似于按摩的手法，但是取出来的麝香不多，也就四成这样，取出来的不完全。

第三种，则是桶槽法，也是李青山准备用的。

李青山准备了一根竹条，当然这竹条是经过修正过大小的，前端也做了特殊的处理，十分光滑，大概能够取出九成的麝香，其中一成要留给香獐子，而且不能破坏了香囊四周的壁，一旦损伤，就会造成感染，死亡率也高，要是新手的话，很大概率会伤到香獐子，也不知道自己究竟取走了多少麝香，还剩下多少的麝香。

李青山则是没这个顾虑。

"I bought the clothes, but there is nothing to do in the old forest." Li Qingshan said.

"Really?"

Rouxue continued to stare into Li Qingshan's eyes and asked.

"Yeah!"

Li Qingshan nodded.

"Actually, Chunxiao is a pretty good girl. She is a golden flower in our village and even in Shiliba Village. She is also a yellow-flowered girl."

"I'm just a widow with a daughter."

"You can't marry someone like me, and I'm not a woman who doesn't know how to behave. Even if you want to marry me, I won't marry you."

"If you also think Chunxiao is good, go ahead and marry her."

"Otherwise, if Chunxiao marries someone else, you will regret it, and this girl must be interested in you, otherwise she wouldn't be able to get your dress."

"Wait until you get married!"

"If you remember me and are still willing to come to me, come and look for me, and we will be a pair of wild mandarin ducks. If you don't want to look for me anymore, it's okay, just forget about me."

Rouxue stared at Li Qingshan and said in a gentle tone: "This is what I am saying and what I am thinking."

Li Qingshan looked at Rouxue in front of him and fell silent.

This is a very measured and sensible woman. If you are willing to look for me, we will be wild mandarin ducks. If you are not willing to look for me, just pretend that nothing happened.

Sensible and heartbreaking!

"Marriage may not last a lifetime!"

"But we can be mandarin ducks for the rest of our lives."

Li Qingshan looked at the sensible Rouxue in front of him and already gave Rouxue the answer in his words.

late at night.

A pair of wild mandarin ducks play in the water.

Early the next morning.

When Li Qingshan left, it was already dark. He leaned against the wall and opened the door. The smell of breakfast at home could already be heard.

"Qingshan, it's time to eat!" I put the food on the table and said.

"Already eaten."

Li Qingshan waved his hand. He ate at Rouxue's house this morning. I have to say that even for breakfast, Rouxue's food was more delicious than my mother's. The craftsmanship was really amazing.

"Have you eaten?"

"Where did you eat?"

My mother, Liu Guixiang, Wang Naixiang and Li Sankui were all slightly startled and looked towards Li Qingshan.

broken……!

"Oh, I just went for a walk by the river, caught a fish, grilled it and ate it!"

"Stop talking, I have to go to the backyard and get the musk as soon as possible."

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, he quickly walked toward the backyard while holding on to the wall.

"Qingshan, what's wrong with your waist? Are you okay?" Liu Guixiang asked.

"Oh, it's okay. I moved my waist while catching the fish. It's not a problem, it's not a problem...you guys eat first...!"

Li Qingshan wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and said.

"Why do you feel like Qingshan is so weird?"

Liu Guixiang frowned slightly, Wang Naixiang and Li Qingshan's mother also had this idea.

After Li Qingshan returned to the room, he first took out the herbal juice prepared on the mountain. This thing was made from datura. This thing does not sound like it comes from our place. In fact, it is common in the old forest. If you encounter it on the mountain in the future, it is best to cultivate it and bring it back.

Backyard, inside wooden fence.

The deer was tied by a rope and lying on the ground for a nap, maybe it was just boring.

As for the fragrant deer, they are much happier. They keep walking in the wooden fence. Now the temperature is getting higher and higher. There are no trees in the wooden fence. It is difficult for these fragrant deer to find a place to enjoy the shade. It is not possible to stay in the nest every day. Therefore, the wooden fence will continue to expand. It is best to surround the entire hillside of the back mountain. This is the backyard of your home. Once enclosed, this place is almost your own.

After next summer, once you donate it to the government, everything will be legal.

This fragrant deer breeding garden is actually more like a shelter for myself. As long as my family has a name in it, they can avoid being affected.

Of course, now I want to expand to the entire back mountain slope.

Obviously unrealistic.

Let's expand the land to one acre first, so that more than half of the area will be expanded with trees, and the fragrant deer will have a place to enjoy the shade in summer.

Now Li Qingshan plans to hand over the management of fragrant deer deer to his old father, but he does not have the time. As for the precautions and skills, he can slowly hand it over to him, and then transfer it to his mother or even his sister-in-law.

As for Wang Naixiang, she was staring at the health station!!

Li Qingshan took out the jade gourd pendant, and a drop of liquid was produced inside it again, which made Li Qingshan look happy.

Just uncorked the bottle.

A light and elegant fragrance floated around. This smell was very light. Li Qingshan could barely smell it when he got closer. However, the deer and fragrant deer in the wooden enclosure smelled it and walked towards Li Qingshan. However, the deer was tied with a rope and could not walk over.

Li Qingshan poured the liquid in the jade gourd onto the young leaves and handed it to the fragrant deer. With a roll of his tongue, the young leaves were rolled into his mouth and chewed.

This fragrant deer seemed to have grown stronger after not being seen overnight.

My spirits have improved a lot.

My guess was indeed correct. The liquid from the jade gourd was indeed good for these animals and could promote their growth.

It is enough to leave a fragrant deer in the wooden enclosure.

As for the other deer, you can consider killing it and skinning it today. After all, we don’t have much meat at home. I have to add that the role of this deer is almost over.

Immediately afterwards.

Li Qingshan took out the datura liquid he prepared, smeared it on the young leaves, and fed it to the fragrant deer in front of him. Not long after eating the fragrant deer, he fell to the ground and fainted.

Find a clean wooden board and place the fragrant deer seeds on it.

He reached out and patted Xiang Deer Zi's face, and found that he was really dizzy. Li Qingshan nodded with satisfaction. Now, if he wants to remove the musk from Xiang Deer Zi, there are three methods, namely the poking method, the surgical method, and the isobaric method.

The most violent surgical method is one that Li Qingshan will never use. It is to cut open directly and then suture. The mortality rate is extremely high. After all, neither the hygiene nor the equipment can meet this requirement.

The second method is the isobaric method. This method is not bad. It is to squeeze the scent sac of the fragrant deer and use some techniques similar to massage. However, not much musk is taken out, only 40% of it is taken out, and it is not completely taken out.

The third type is the barrel method, which Li Qingshan plans to use.

Li Qingshan prepared a bamboo stick. Of course, this bamboo stick was resized and had a special treatment on the front end. It was very smooth. It could take out about 90% of the musk, 10% of which should be left for the fragrant deer. The wall around the sachet must not be damaged. Once damaged, it would cause infection and the mortality rate would be high. If you are a novice, you will most likely hurt the fragrant deer. You don't know how much musk you have taken away and how much musk is left.

Li Qingshan has no such concerns.
